title: Trump names Adam Telle acting Army secretary after Driscoll’s departure

title: EPA proposal could leave the public in the dark on data center plans
summary: The EPA proposal would eliminate a federal requirement that states notify the public and seek comment before issuing air pollution permits for data centers.

title: MSPB finalizes major shift in federal employee misconduct cases
summary: Instead of using the Douglas factors, MSPB will judge whether an agency’s penalty for an employee accused of misconduct was reasonable on a case-by-case basis.

title: Pentagon plans fleet of portable SCIFs
summary: The initiative may allow more nontraditional contractors to contribute to national security, collaborate with government teams and compete for classified work.

title: Minnesota bringing more government organizations under its cyber umbrella
summary: John Israel, the chief information security officer for the state of Minnesota, said a cross-state task force helps drive statewide cyber priorities.

title: The data we protect vs. the data we should
summary: The adversaries here are well-resourced nation-states with explicit intent and demonstrated capability to exploit exactly what they steal.

title: Holding agencies accountable for their human capital
summary: Ronald Sanders, a NAPA fellow, former OPM associate director and former agency CHCO, explains why HR leaders should be treated like adults and held accountable.

title: Move your money or let it ride? Staying the TSP after retirement
summary: On this episode of Fed Thread, Chris Campbell walks us through what happens when your TSP shifts from an accumulation tool to a source of retirement income.

title: There’s been a shift in where people earning STEM Ph.D.s are ending up
summary: "Today, we produce many more Ph.D.s in computer science, but about three-quarters of those Ph.D.s are going anywhere but academia" said Dr. Erwin Gianchandani.

summary: "It's going to be a very subjective analysis for institutions and for agencies to determine what research actually falls into these buckets," said Cara Baer.

title: Driscoll offers no reason for his exit as Army secretary but says Wednesday is his last full day
summary: Any concerns were absent from Driscoll's Tuesday night X post, which was his first public statement since the White House confirmed his departure on Monday.
